_doc: Hand-entered rule inputs for the 20 holdout cases, in the shape of ../inputs.json. input_facts: only what the neutral concept text (cases.yaml concept_input) states, coded by two readers who could not see each other's work (first = reading-A.json, second = reading-B.json); differences settled as listed in input_facts_readings_differed. record_facts: the facts as the decision record shows them, read twice independently and settled from the record where the readings differed (record_facts_settled lists each; 'took' says which reading was kept, 'neither' when the record gave a third value). The local ABC copy and other data outside the decision record are not used for record_facts. rules_date is the day before filing. intake_answers: the optional intake questions (part of a chain and how many other locations; floor area; how the liquor licence will be obtained), answered only where the case file states the fact; an absent key is a skipped question. Written 2026-11-12, before any rule change; frozen with the holdout (README.md section 6).
